summary.text: Debra Gardner is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 76, which covers part of Chesterfield County.
Debra Gardner has been a member since January 10, 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Debra Gardner was born in Shelby, North Carolina, in 1956.
Debra Gardner studied at North Carolina Central University (B.A., Sociology, 1974) and Virginia Commonwealth University (Master of Public Administration, 2001).
Debra Gardner's listed occupation is retired and a small business owner.

Debra Gardner's listed memberships and affiliations include the boards of Thrive Birth to Five and the Virginia League of Planned Parenthood, Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Inc., and Jack and Jill of America.

The House profile lists Debra Gardner's committee assignments as Finance, Health and Human Services, and Public Safety, and Debra Gardner chairs the Behavioral Health subcommittee of Health and Human Services.
